title: Get to get (together)
lyrics:
[intro]
[acoustic guitar strumming with percussive backbeat]

[chorus]
Why don't we-e-e
Get-to-get-to-get together
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
Why don't we-e-e [falsetto]
Get-to-get-to-get together
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho

[verse]
We are, I see your beautiful shadow
In the night
I see you are so beautiful
And it makes me fright
And I see that you are so beautiful
I know it's true
You know it's true
You know it's true
You know it's true
So I say

[chorus]
Why don't we-e-e
Get-to-get-to-get together
Ba-da-pa-pa-pa
Why don't we-e-e [falsetto]
Get-to-get-to-get together
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
And I said why don't we-e-e
Get-to-get-to-get together
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha
Why don't we-e-e [falsetto]
Get-to-get-to-get together
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho

[verse]
And I see your beautiful body
And I smile
And I wonder if you have a boyfriend
How far is a mile?
And I just hope that you will be my lady
If I do the things
That you want
That you need
That I know you want to hear
It's so-ho true
'Cause I say

[chorus]
Why don't we-e-e
Get-to-get-to-get together
Ba-da-pa-pa-pa
Why don't we-e-e [falsetto]
Get-to-get-to-get together
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho
[vocal fades to humming]
[guitar final strum]
